# Feature <-> settings/worker map

Every fleet-sending worker gates its slots through the shared budget:
`free slots = fleet slots - General.SlotsToLeaveFree`, allocated by the numeric
`General.SlotPriorityLevel.*` priorities (lower = served first) and each feature's `MaxSlots`.
A worker is enabled iff its own `Active` and (for Brain sub-features) `Brain.Active`; several
checks additionally require `Brain.Transports.Active` when they send transport fleets.
`SleepMode` is not a worker: it is always registered and decides via `HandleSleepModeAsync`
whether other features run (`InitializeFeatures` on wake, stop on sleep).

Initial due-times per feature are hard-coded in `TBotMain.InitializeFeature` (see column
Initial due-time; values from `RandomizeHelper.CalcRandomInterval(IntervalType.*)`:
AFewSeconds 5-15 s, SomeSeconds 20-50 s, AMinuteOrTwo 40-140 s).

| Feature enum | Worker | Settings section | Initial due-time / period semantics |
|---|---|---|---|
| SleepMode | always-on (TBotMain timers; not a worker) | SleepMode.* | SleepModeTimer / TelegramSleepModeTimer / GhostSleepTimer; HandleSleepModeAsync state machine, 1-minute-or-two jitter on transitions. |
| Defender | DefenderWorker (Feature.Defender) | Defender.* | DueTime AFewSeconds; period CheckIntervalMin..Max minutes. |
| BrainAutoCargo | AutoCargoWorker | Brain.AutoCargo.* | DueTime AMinuteOrTwo. |
| BrainAutobuildDefence | AutoDefenceWorker | Brain.AutoDefence.* | DueTime AMinuteOrTwo. |
| BrainAutoRepatriate | AutoRepatriateWorker + FleetScheduler | Brain.AutoRepatriate.* | DueTime SomeSeconds. |
| BrainAutoMine | AutoMineWorker + per-celestial AutoMineCelestialWorker | Brain.AutoMine.* | DueTime AFewSeconds; per-celestial period CheckInterval minutes. |
| BrainLifeformAutoMine | LifeformsAutoMineWorker + celestial workers | Brain.LifeformAutoMine.* | DueTime AFewSeconds. |
| BrainLifeformAutoResearch | LifeformsAutoResearchWorker + celestial workers | Brain.LifeformAutoResearch.* | DueTime AFewSeconds. |
| BrainOfferOfTheDay | BuyOfferOfTheDayWorker | Brain.BuyOfferOfTheDay.* | DueTime SomeSeconds. |
| BrainAutoResearch | AutoResearchWorker | Brain.AutoResearch.* | DueTime SomeSeconds. |
| BrainAutoFleepJumpGate | AutoFleetJumpGateWorker | Brain.AutoFleepJumpGate.* | DueTime SomeSeconds; note AutoFleep spelling. |
| AutoFarm | AutoFarmWorker | AutoFarm.* | DueTime AMinuteOrTwo. |
| Expeditions | ExpeditionsWorker | Expeditions.* | DueTime AMinuteOrTwo; waits in seconds. |
| Harvest | HarvestWorker | AutoHarvest.* | DueTime SomeSeconds. |
| Colonize | ColonizeWorker | AutoColonize.* | DueTime SomeSeconds. |
| AutoDiscovery | AutoDiscoveryWorker | AutoDiscovery.* | DueTime SomeSeconds. |
